ValidationRule.description: Prevents Non System Admins from moving to a previous stage; only allows moving to next stages.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISCHANGED(Status__c), CASE(Status__c, "Draft", 1, "Submitted", 2, "1st Level Approved", 3, "2nd Level Approved", 4, "3rd Level Approved", 5, "4th Level Approved", 6, 0 ) < CASE(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Draft", 1, "Submitted", 2, "1st Level Approved", 3, "2nd Level Approved", 4, "3rd Level Approved", 5, "4th Level Approved", 6, 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have the necessary permissions to go back to the previous stage.
